voices.title: Voices

library.title: Voice Library
library.description: Create custom voices and discover community-shared voices for your projects

voices.sharedVoices: {count} shared {count, plural, one { voice} other { voices}}

delete.title: Delete Voice
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete this voice? This action cannot be undone and the voice will be removed from all your projects.

share.title: Share Voice with Community
share.description: Your voice will be submitted for admin review. Once approved, it will be available to all users and won't count toward your voice limit. This helps build our community library!

unshare.title: Make Voice Private
unshare.description: Your voice will be withdrawn from review and made private again. It will only be accessible to you and will count toward your voice limit.

privateInfo.title: Private Voices
privateInfo.description: Your private voice recordings. Share them with the community for admin review. Once approved, they'll appear in the Community tab and won't count toward your voice limit.

communityInfo.title: Community Voices
communityInfo.description: Approved voices shared by our community. All voices here are free to use in your projects. Your approved voices appear here and don't count toward your voice limit.

private.title: No private voices
private.description: Start by recording a voice sample. Your voice will be cloned and ready to use in your projects. Share them with the community to earn extra voice slots!

community.title: No community voices yet
community.description: Community voices will appear here once users share their voices and they're approved by our team. Be the first to contribute!

toasts.voiceShareedDescription: Your voice has been submitted for review
toasts.voiceMadePrivateDescription: Your voice is no longer shared
toasts.voiceDeletedDescription: Your voice has been deleted successfully
